content:
🎉 Exciting News 🎉

I am thrilled to share that I have joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! 🚀 Since 2017, I have been deeply involved with the CDS Hooks standard, and this new role is an honor that will allow me to contribute further to advancing this innovative technology.

CDS Hooks is transforming how clinical decision support is integrated into electronic health records, and I am eager to help guide its ongoing development and adoption. 🌐

For those already using CDS Hooks, I encourage you to share your implementation experiences on the community GitHub page: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability. Your insights are invaluable to the community.

If you haven't started your CDS Hooks journey yet, I’m available as a freelance consultant. I would love to help you understand and implement this standard to enhance your systems' capabilities and efficiency.

Together, let's shape the future of clinical decision support! 💡

#CDSHooks #HealthIT #ClinicalDecisionSupport #ProjectManagement #DigitalHealth #Innovation #Consulting
